environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS behind an NGINX Ingress Controller configured with ssl_verify_client=on and ssl_client_certificate pointing to an internal CA bundle (/etc/nginx/certs/client-ca.pem). The ingress annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-verify-client is set to 'on' with auth-tls-verify-depth of 2. Additionally, the ingress has nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-error-page configured to return 495 for failed client cert validation. The pod runs with a NetworkPolicy that restricts egress to only the cluster DNS (kube-dns on port 53/UDP) and a curated allowlist of external CIDR blocks that excludes 169.254.0.0/16 and all RFC1918 ranges. The NetworkPolicy uses both podSelector and namespaceSelector with matchLabels requiring app=graphql-gateway AND namespace=production.

config.ingress: NGINX Ingress Controller v1.9.4 with mutual TLS enforcement (ssl_verify_client=on, client CA from internal PKI)
config.notes: Client certificates are issued only to authorized service mesh sidecars via cert-manager with a ClusterIssuer backed by Vault PKI
